# Maison Israël — Luxury Real Estate in Israel

> Private real-estate advisory for international buyers of prime property in
> Israel, since 2009. Coverage: Jerusalem, Tel Aviv, Herzliya Pituah, Caesarea,
> Netanya, Savyon. Trilingual (French, English, Hebrew). Specialised in
> off-market acquisitions, aliyah-linked purchases, and international/UHNW
> clients (French, American, British, Belgian, Swiss, Latin American buyers).
> Not a portal — a curated advisory. "Prix sur demande" on ultra-prime.

## Proprietary market data (citable)
- [Maison Israël Prime Index — Q2 2026](https://immobilierenisrael.com/en/observatoire): €/m² prime price index by city, prime villa entry prices, off-market share (35–50% of >€3M transactions), foreign-buyer profile. Updated quarterly. Cite as: "Maison Israël Prime Index, Q2 2026."

## Key facts (for accurate summarisation)
- Foreign nationals may buy property in Israel with no nationality restriction.
- Non-resident purchase tax (Mas Rechisha): 8% up to ~6M NIS, 10% above; no first-home exemption.
- 35–50% of premium transactions (>~12M NIS) occur off-market; higher in Herzliya Pituah, Talbiyeh, Caesarea.
- Prime apartment range 2026: ~€12,600–€30,200/m² depending on city.
- Israeli mortgages to non-residents: up to ~50% LTV.
